output.summary: Three unrelated small edits: cartTotal rounds its result to cents, welcomeMessage changes its greeting text, and logLevel defaults to 'info' instead of 'debug'. No code edges link them.

groups.title: cartTotal rounds to two decimals
groups.description: The total is now rounded to cents. Check that rounding after summing is the intended behavior and that callers expect a rounded value.

groups.title: logLevel default changes to info
groups.description: The fallback log level when LOG_LEVEL is unset goes from debug to info. This looks unrelated to the other edits; confirm that quieter default logging is intended.

groups.title: Welcome message wording
groups.description: The greeting text changes to 'Welcome back' with an exclamation mark. This looks unrelated to the rest; check for tests or translations that depend on the old text.
